预览并启用 clangd 范围配置: Preview and Enable clangd Scope Configuration
预览并移除 clangd 范围配置: Preview and Remove clangd Scope Configuration
重新扫描当前工程并重建本地索引: Rescan Workspace and Rebuild Local Index
选择代码中的符号以查看定义: Select a symbol to preview its definition
源码已修改，请刷新预览后再跳转: Source changed. Refresh the preview before navigating.
未找到包含函数，请使用向上 / 向下浏览: No enclosing function found. Use earlier / later lines.
函数超过 2000 行，显示首段；可继续向下浏览: Function exceeds 2000 lines. Showing first part; continue with later lines.
执行 Lookup References 查询符号引用: Use Lookup References to find symbol references
本地 C 绑定引用 · 包含声明 · 条件分支未求值: Local C bound references · includes declarations · preprocessor conditions not evaluated
本地绑定不唯一，无法确认引用；请配置语言服务: Local binding is ambiguous. Configure a language service.
输入字符，搜索当前文件夹: Enter text to search the current folder
源码或文件夹已变化，请刷新检索: Source or scope changed. Refresh the search.
请先打开并选择工作区文件夹: Open and select a workspace folder first
请输入不超过 256 个字符的单行检索内容: Enter up to 256 characters; enable multiline for line breaks
选择键位预设；可在设置中分别修改: Choose a key preset; individual keys can be changed in Settings
本地 C 索引不求值条件编译。: The local C index does not evaluate preprocessor conditions.
安装语言扩展不代表语义服务已就绪；检查语言扩展输出和编译数据库。: An installed language extension may still be initializing. Check its output and compilation database.
导出不包含源码、路径、查询文本、笔记或编译参数；导出前仍请检查内容。: The report excludes source, paths, queries, notes and compiler arguments. Review it before sharing.
请先打开需要保存的位置: Open the location before saving it
保存的位置已被屏蔽或不在工作区内: The saved location is excluded or outside this workspace
位置已删除或存在多个相同候选，请重新定位: The location was deleted or has multiple candidates. Locate it again.
书签笔记（仅保存在当前工作区的插件存储中）: Bookmark note (stored only in this workspace extension storage)
书签已达 1000 项，请先删除旧项: Bookmark limit (1000) reached. Delete older entries first.
原检索范围已不可用，请重新选择范围: The original search scope is unavailable. Select a new scope.
选择关系；能力由当前语言服务或本地索引决定: Choose a relation; availability depends on the language service or local index
当前 VS Code 或语言服务未提供类型层次入口: This VS Code or language service has no type hierarchy command
当前范围没有结果；请检查能力诊断和语言服务配置: No results in this scope. Check diagnostics and language configuration.
仅维护标记块；原配置会备份，关闭自动维护可移除标记块: Only managed blocks change. Originals are backed up. Disable management to remove blocks.
使用 F2 固定符号高亮: Use F2 for Same-name Text Highlight
只保存修改项，切换标签保留未保存修改；工作区设置优先于用户设置。点击保存立即应用: Only modified settings are saved. Switching tabs keeps edits. Workspace settings override user settings. Use Save and Reload when a reload is needed.
允许跨行匹配；正则的点也匹配换行，Shift+Enter 输入换行: Allow matches across lines; regex dot also matches newlines. Shift+Enter inserts a newline.
点击或 Ctrl+点击查看定义或声明，Shift+点击查看类型定义: Click or Ctrl+click for definition; Shift+click for type definition
点击或 Enter 定位源码；双击固定标签页；Alt+点击在 Context 预: Click or Enter to open; double-click to pin; Alt+click to preview
选择符号以查看定义: Select a symbol to preview its definition
已锁定；解锁后选择符号: Locked. Unlock and select a symbol.
已取消查询；可刷新当前预览: Query cancelled. Refresh the current preview.
定义和符号查询策略：auto 优先在短预算内查询语言服务，再回退到本地 C 语法: Definition and symbol strategy: auto tries the language service with a short budget, then the local C index. local uses C syntax only; languageService uses the installed provider.
引用等显式查询等待上限（毫秒）；自动定义使用至多 500ms 的语义等待，再尝试: Explicit query timeout in milliseconds. Automatic definitions wait up to 500ms for semantics before bounded C fallback. Timed-out underlying work retains its concurrency slot.
全局符号搜索等待语言服务的上限（毫秒）；Java / Python 大项目可适当: Maximum wait for language-service workspace symbols (ms). Increase for large Java or Python projects.
光标停留时自动在 Context 预览定义。: Preview the selected symbol definition automatically after the cursor settles.
未锁定时 Relation 跟随当前函数。: Follow the current function in Relation when unlocked.
Context 目标上下显示的行数。: Lines before and after the Context target.
工程文件查找的额外排除 glob；支持 *、?、**，遵循 files.excl: Extra project-file exclusion globs. Supports *, ?, ** and respects files.exclude.
工程文件查找的包含 glob，空数组显示全部。: Project-file include globs. An empty array includes all files.
启用 Source Insight 风格的 Alt+=、Alt+,、Alt+.，: Opt in to Source Insight keys: Alt+=, Alt+comma, Alt+period, Shift+F12 and F8. Disabled by default.
Context 默认查看当前符号自身的定义或声明，变量和字段不自动跳到类型；也可: Preview the symbol definition/declaration, an explicit type definition, or the enclosing function. Variables and fields keep their own definitions by default.
默认显示文件全部符号，包括 C/C++ 头文件包含、宏、全局变量、结构体、枚举和: Show all symbols, including includes, macros, globals, types and functions, or functions and their containers only.
控制底部阅读面板布局；默认不改变侧栏左右位置。Explorer 位置由 expl: Preserve existing views by default. Apply the reading layout explicitly to reveal reading views. Native panel position and alignment remain under user control.
主侧栏位置；默认首次应用左侧 Explorer 与符号列表、右侧工程文件。后续手: Primary sidebar location when a reading layout is applied explicitly. Preserve keeps the current side.
原生 Explorer 和符号列表所在的主侧栏放在左侧: Place primary sidebar on the left
原生 Explorer 和符号列表所在的主侧栏放在右侧: Place primary sidebar on the right
Relation 调用关系分析后端。auto 优先语言服务并在不可用时回退本地: Call relation backend. auto tries the language service then C syntax fallback. Local C does not evaluate preprocessor conditions or infer indirect calls.
优先使用语言服务，不可用时回退内置 C 语法索引: Prefer language service, then local C fallback
本地 C 索引扫描排除规则（VS Code glob）。修改后自动重新扫描，也可: Local C index exclusion glob. Changes trigger a rescan; Rebuild Local C Index forces content verification.
Relation 的显示方式。横向图同时显示当前函数的直接调用者和直接调用函数；: Horizontal graph shows direct callers and callees. Outline supports recursive expansion.
横向图：调用者 → 当前函数 → 调用函数，各一层: Direct callers → current function → direct callees
文件夹字符检索额外排除规则；同时遵循 files.exclude / searc: Extra text-search exclusion glob. Also respects files.exclude and search.exclude entries set to true.
使用 F2 固定 / 取消同名符号高亮，覆盖 F2 原有重命名；关闭后保留 Ct: Opt in to F2 same-name text highlighting, replacing Rename. Ctrl+Alt+H and commands remain available.
本地索引调用关系单次等待上限（毫秒），索引建立中不会无限阻塞窗口: Single local call relation timeout (ms); index building does not block forever.
同一工作区 / 语言 / 查询方向连续两次超时后暂停自动重试的时间（毫秒），手动: Automatic retry cooldown after two timeouts for the same workspace/language/direction (ms). Manual refresh retries immediately.
启用本地 C 索引，为符号、定义及调用关系查询提供数据；独立于 Relation: Enable the local C index for symbols, definitions, bound references and calls, independently of Relation backend.
屏蔽目录及其全部子目录，在扫描前排除。支持相对工作区路径、工作区内绝对路径或 U: Exclude directory subtrees before scanning. Supports workspace-relative paths, absolute paths within roots and URIs.
根据屏蔽的文件和目录自动维护工作区 .clangd 的后台索引排除规则，保留已有: Opt in to managed .clangd exclusion blocks. Use the preview command first. Originals are backed up; disabling removes only the managed block.
屏蔽指定文件。可在工程文件树中 Shift 连选或 Ctrl / Cmd 多选后: Exclude selected files. Use Shift or Ctrl/Cmd selection in Project Files.
各阅读窗口的字体、字号、文字和背景颜色。使用 **SourceInsight-R: Per-view fonts, sizes, foreground and background. Empty values inherit the theme. Edit in Settings > Appearance.
调用者、当前函数与调用函数，横向一层关系图: Direct callers, current function and direct callees
配置阅读、符号、调用关系、索引、屏蔽、布局与快捷键。列表规则每行一项，逗号保留在: Configure reading, symbols, calls, indexing, exclusions, layout and keys. Lists use one entry per line; commas stay in each entry.
配置颜色、字体、字号和窗口背景。宏与枚举成员默认定义蓝色、引用红色；语义颜色优先: Configure colors, fonts, sizes and backgrounds. Macro/enum definitions default to blue and references to red. Semantic colors override syntax colors.
每行一项；清空表示空列表: One entry per line; empty means an empty list
修改内容过长，请减少列表内容后保存: Changes are too long. Shorten the lists before saving.
本地 C 语法索引 · 条件分支未求值: Local C syntax index · preprocessor conditions not evaluated
· 位置可能过期，请重新定位符号: · Location may be stale; locate the symbol again
选择要清除的工作区阅读数据: Choose Workspace Reading Data to Clear
删除所选阅读数据？此操作无法撤销，源码不受影响。: Delete selected reading data? This cannot be undone. Source files are unaffected.
定义、符号和引用查询策略：auto 优先语言服务，再尝试基础 C 回退；loca: Definition, symbol and reference strategy: auto prefers language services, then basic C fallback; local uses C syntax only; languageService uses installed providers. See the support matrix for empty reference behavior.
默认保留现有视图布局。显式应用时显示阅读视图；原生面板位置和对齐由用户控制，主侧: Preserve existing views by default. Apply the reading layout explicitly to reveal reading views. Native panel position and alignment remain under user control.
显式应用阅读布局时的主侧栏位置。preserve 保留当前左右位置，不迁移用户已: Primary sidebar location when a reading layout is applied explicitly. Preserve keeps the current side.
本地 C Worker 的 JS 堆上限（MiB），默认 1024。修改后重建线: Local C Worker JavaScript heap ceiling (MiB). Default 1024. Applies after recreating the worker. Scans stop admitting new files before the ceiling, retain explicitly incomplete results and never auto-restart an OOM loop. This is not a total process-memory limit.
暂无本地索引问题；索引尚未完成时请稍后重试: No local index issues; retry once indexing has finished
选择文件查看索引问题（最多5000项）；解析不完整的文件仍可使用已收录符号: Select an index issue (up to 5000); recognized symbols in partially parsed files remain available
本地索引 CPU 预算，最高 25%。协调和解析线程共享额度，根据可用 CPU: Local indexing CPU budget, at most 25%. Coordinator and parser threads share the allowance through bounded concurrency and CPU-time throttling. Native parsing/GC may cause brief bursts; this is not an OS hard quota. Language-service threads have their own limits.
全部本地索引线程共享的 JS 堆与缓冲区预算（MiB），默认 1024，并根据系: Shared JavaScript heap and buffer budget for all local index threads (MiB), default 1024, further constrained by available system memory. Parser threads share this allowance. Pressure reduces concurrency or retains explicitly partial results; process memory growth is also monitored. V8 heap ceilings do not directly constrain WASM/SQLite or other VS Code components.
